stories.title: Bank of Canada weighs rate move amid weak growth and rising inflation
stories.summary: Canada’s economy is described as weak while inflation rose to 3.1 % in the most recent month, with core‑inflation measures remaining subdued. The Bank of Canada will decide on interest‑rate policy on Wednesday; raising rates would further weaken growth, whereas cutting rates could let inflation accelerate. Governor Tiff Macklem was seen at a news conference in Ottawa on June 10, 2026.
stories.why: Inflation data can shift expectations for central-bank interest rates, bond yields, borrowing costs and household purchasing power.
stories.previousTitle: Bank of Canada likely to raise rates as inflation hits 3.1%
stories.previousSummary: Canada’s inflation rose to 3.1% in the most recent month, while core inflation stayed subdued. The economy is described as weak and the effect of a new round of tariffs remains unclear. Based on these conditions, most major forecasters now expect the Bank of Canada to raise its key overnight lending rate at its upcoming decision.

stories.title: US stocks rise as Anthropic IPO filing lifts AI sentiment, Tesla hits three‑month high
stories.summary: The S&P 500 gained 0.70% to close at 7,677.03, the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.83% to 26,169.38, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 0.28% to 52,361.76. Gains were driven by Anthropic’s IPO filing, which revived optimism for AI‑related stocks, while investors also focused on a busy earnings week and the Federal Reserve’s policy decision; Tesla reached a more‑than‑three‑month high.
stories.why: The rally reflects renewed confidence in AI companies, supporting broader equity market performance.

stories.title: Chris Brown given suspended eight-month prison sentence over nightclub attack
stories.summary: **US singer Chris Brown has avoided jail after striking a man twice in the head with a glass tequila bottle in a London nightclub.** The R&B star was given an eight-month prison sentence, suspended for 12 months, over the attack at private members' club Tape in Mayfair, in the early hours of 19 February 2023. Brown's vocal coach, rapper Omololu Akinlolu, who joined the attack, was sentenced to four months' imprisonment, suspended for 12 months.

stories.title: Nurse killed in attack while responding to Ebola alert in DR Congo
stories.summary: A nurse has been killed and another health worker seriously injured in an attack as they were responding to an Ebola alert in north-eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. More than 4,800 people have died and nearly 10,000 been infected in DR Congo since this outbreak began in May.
stories.why: This matters because it could expand treatment options or demonstrate a clinically meaningful new medical technology.
stories.previousTitle: Nurse killed, health worker injured in Ebola response attack in north‑eastern DRC
stories.previousSummary: A nurse has been killed and another health worker seriously injured when local youths attacked them as they responded to an Ebola alert in north‑eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, accusing them of contaminating water and spreading the virus. The World Health Organization condemned the attack, while neighbouring Uganda banned non‑essential travel to and from the DRC and quarantined returning citizens for 21 days. The outbreak has caused more than 4,800 deaths and nearly 10,000 infections since it began in May.
